resources.string: Several saved connections, starting with this one if you agree to share it; a mountpoint chosen by tapping it in the list or on the map; watch mode for runs lasting hours, with a stability report; a network-RTK check with its own assertions, and the reference position watched over a run; self-position, where the station’s own observations put it; satellite trails and a second stream for a complete sky view; per-message statistics, statistics export, and import and export of the shared configuration file. The eight checks and their verdicts are identical in both editions.
